notes.title: Patch V1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch  V1.0.4[/b][/h1] 

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Menu button won't work after Return to menu from game
[*] Subtitle in cinematics & UI for each screen format
[*] tutorial UI text and animation for each screen format
[*] bush not respawning after death
[*] The game won't go back to main menu at the end
[/list]

[h3][b]Users Experience[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Add 21:9 / 16:10 / 4:3  screen support
[*] Add mouse support in the menu
[*] Add Joystick control in the all menus
[*] Change "Continue" button by an Icon in "Death Screen"
[*] Add a control layout image in "Pause menu"
[/list]

[h3][b]Gameplay change:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The player can't be interrupt by enemies when charging the heavy attack now
[*] Change camera behavior for smoother gameplay
[*] Rebalance the positioning/numbers of enemies & Health Tikis
[/list]

[h3][b]Know issue:[/b][/h3]
The game doesn't have Vsync, some [b]tearing effect is produce[/b]. Due to performance issue the game don't have the Vsync parameters at the moment, if you experiencing Tearing you can activate [b]"fast sync"[/b] in you [b]Vsync parameter in Nvidia contol panel[/b]

Thank for your feedbacks ! ːsteamthumbsupː
